# 3.1 Web GIS, WASM, and Shiny

## Story problem

**Why does my dashboard feel slow?**

- A Folium map loads quickly, then the app becomes sluggish.
- You learn where computation happens and how to move work upstream.
- You learn to keep packages and data lean for the web.

## What you will learn

- What runs in the browser versus on the server.
- Why large Python packages slow down browser-based deployments.
- How to choose a deployment approach for a Folium-first app.
